title: Vite
description: Next-generation frontend tooling with native ESM.

data.text: Vite (French for "quick") provides instant server start and lightning-fast hot updates by leveraging native ES modules.
In development, Vite serves files as native ESM. No bundling is needed. In production, it uses Rollup to bundle optimized assets.

data.caption: Create a Vite project
data.code:
npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react-ts
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev

data.definition:
flowchart LR
